title: Magee, John Eglinton
html_source: William Kirkpatrick Magee and John Eglinton were in fact one & the same person, the latter being the pseudonym of the former. Confusingly, Joyce/Stephen use both names throughout this episode.

anchor.prefix:
wn. 

 Good Bacon: gone musty. Shakespeare Bacon's wild oats. Cypherjugglers going the highroads. Seekers on the great quest. What town, good masters? Mummed in names: A. E., eon:
anchor.suffix:
. East of the sun, west of the moon: Tir na n-og. Booted the twain and staved. 

How many miles to Dublin?
Three score and ten, sir. 
Will we be there by candlelight? 

 — Mr Brand
